briefs.title: Grok Bot calling + vault features; frontier still stable
points: Grok Bot ~0.77 (community reports, Musk-confirmed Oct 25): Bot can dial a person or business, sit on hold, press keys, get transferred while user watches live transcript; make request on behalf, take notes, summarize conversation. Builds on prior voice and phone app integrations.

Vault feature: Bot securely saves logins, cards, and contact information once; remembers for future use. Payments screen to connect accounts and pick default (on top of Vault). Sharing/invites require Premium or Ultra. Tailscale private network join pending admin approval.

Musk continues high-volume promotion of Grok Bot as “super competent employee” / life & business manager. Amplifying user stories (shopping, payments, content, calendar) and framing “best way to use is assume you are hiring.” Car login with main Bot floated. No new model ship.

@AlexFinn (Oct 26): Reviewed AI apps on iPhone Duo. Grok Bot “really good” but only major AI app not yet optimized for Duo. ChatGPT and Claude both great; Meta Muse “something completely different (10/10).” Earlier: Grok Bot #1 currently, Duet has a shot.

Frontier map unchanged: Claude Opus 5.5 still leads independent AA Intelligence Index at 57.6 (max). Sonnet 5.5 56, Fable 5.1 53.4, GPT-6 Astra 52.7, Gemini 4 Argon 52.6, GPT-6.1 Sol 51.8. Grok 4.7 remains ~46.4 at $2/$6 — value mid-tier, not composite peak. No Grok 4.8 release; still only prior Musk mentions. Kimi K3.1 Pro (Oct 23) at 55.1 noted in trackers but not a closed flagship shift.
briefs.assumption: Calling, vault, and payments features confirmed via Musk posts and detailed community screenshots (0.77). Reliability, error rates on live calls (hold/transfer), full cost (including any routed models), and scale not independently measured. AlexFinn Duo review is practitioner product signal. AA Index scores consistent with multiple independent trackers as of Oct 26; no new flagship model shipped by any major lab since prior brief.
